name: auto-velog
description: Session-driven blog automation: a SessionStart hook asks the model to emit ★ BlogWorthy blocks when a debugging war story, discovery, methodology, or optimization worth writing about appears; a Stop hook harvests them into a queue and spawns a detached draft pipeline that scores the candidate, writes a human-toned post from the actual session transcript, runs a blocking secret/PII scan, and publishes to Velog through a pluggable adapter. Publish mode defaults to approve; auto mode is opt-in.
